messages:
Maya (People Ops): quick heads-up — final onsite panel for the SRE candidate is Thurs 11:30am PT. We need room, laptop access, and a rubric check. @Sam can you confirm room & AV?
Sam (SRE): putting in a room hold now, will confirm AV. Do we need a spare laptop for hands-on exercise? :thinking_face:
Devin (Recruiter): candidate will be remote. They asked for a test command to run if we do a live exercise — prefer recorded task?
Luke (Hiring Manager): remote is fine. plan: 30m behavioral + 45m technical (incl. short debugging exercise). No live infra access needed — we'll do a pastebin/terminal share.
Priya (Eng Mgr): quick rubric question — should scoring emphasize on-call troubleshooting vs system design? I want to align graders.
Maya (People Ops): good call. Hiring rubric note: emphasize troubleshooting and incident reasoning for SRE role. But weigh design for senior signals. Suggest we call out weights.
Sam (SRE): agreed. Proposed weights: Troubleshooting 50%, System design 30%, Communication 20%.
Luke (Hiring Manager): that sounds right. Also: please use this quick scoring scale in debriefs:
```
4 = Strong hire (clear impact, reliable on-call)
3 = Hire (meets bar with some growth areas)
2 = Borderline (needs follow-up or risky)
1 = No hire (doesn't meet essential bar)
```
Priya (Eng Mgr): thanks. One more: do we require a written debrief form or just the slate tool notes?
Maya (People Ops): written debrief in the slate tool within 24h please. If any strong concerns, ping me directly.
Devin (Recruiter): calendar invite sent, candidate confirmed. Interviewers: check email for prep packet.
interview-bot: Interview packet uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/interviews/1933334444 (panel agenda + rubric).
Sam (SRE): room confirmed: Conf-3A, AV tested. I'll join 10 min early to set up screen share. :thumbsup:
Luke (Hiring Manager): calling out timezones — candidate is PT, panelists on ET please use calendar auto-adjust.
Priya (Eng Mgr): will take the troubleshooting slot. @Sam can you take system design?
Sam (SRE): yep taking design slot.
Maya (People Ops): action items recap — Sam: AV + design exercise; Priya: lead troubleshooting; Luke: run interview; Devin: follow-up scheduling; everyone: submit slate debrief within 24h. Any objections?
Luke (Hiring Manager): none from me. all good.
Devin (Recruiter): all set. sending reminder 1h before. :bell:
__note: This file is a synthetic Slack thread for people-ops panel logistics — formatted as a single continuous string of messages.
